_comment: ONLY add config to this file if it is ACCEPTANCE TEST related and you wish to override the config from the website
_ConnectionStrings_comment: Its own database, deliberately. Every host and test suite used to point at the same LocalDB
'LondonFhirService', so running the suites concurrently - which is what 'dotnet test' on the
solution does - had them creating, seeding and deleting each other's rows, producing failures
that vanished on re-run in isolation. Each suite migrates its own database at startup via
Database.Migrate(), so no extra provisioning step is needed.
_LdsConfigurations_comment: Only baseUrl, and only because startup refuses to continue without a valid absolute URI
there. The host's own appsettings.json ships that key as the literal string
is not a URI - so every developer supplies a real one from appsettings.Development.json,
which is gitignored. A clean checkout therefore could not start this host at all, and CI
never noticed because the unit test step failed first and skipped the acceptance step.
The value is deliberately unroutable: .invalid is reserved by RFC 2606 and resolves
nowhere. Nothing dials it - TestWebApplicationFactory removes the IFhirAbstractionProvider
registration and substitutes test providers - so this exists purely to satisfy the guard.
